title: Solana
blurb: Agent wallets, signing backends, smart accounts, multisigs and MCP servers built for Solana, the first home of this list.

title: Embedded Wallets and Wallet Infrastructure
blurb: Wallet-as-a-service and embedded wallet SDKs that give apps and agents programmatic wallets with login, policies and multi-chain support.

title: MPC, TEE and Custody
blurb: Threshold signing libraries, trusted execution environments and custody SDKs that keep agent keys out of any single machine.

title: Smart Accounts and Session Keys
blurb: ERC-4337 and ERC-7579 accounts, modules and delegation frameworks for scoped, revocable agent permissions on EVM chains.

title: Spend Limits and Policy Engines
blurb: Wallets and toolkits where spend caps, allowlists, approvals and role-based rules decide what an agent can sign.

title: Wallet MCP Servers, Skills and Payments
blurb: MCP servers, agent skills and payment protocols that let model clients hold wallets, sign and pay.

title: Agent Toolkits
blurb: Toolkits that bundle wallets with onchain actions for agent frameworks.

title: Standards and Libraries
blurb: Wallet standards, ERCs and core libraries the rest of the ecosystem builds on.
